releaseBoundary: This is a manually pinned primary-source security baseline. It is not a live updater. Refresh checkedAt, versions, securityFixCount and reference before every public Direct release. A zero securityFixCount means the official Stable post did not enumerate security fixes; it never means that the version is exempt from the minimum-version gate.
policy: A public NeAntik Direct build must not ship an older Chromium version than the latest security-patched macOS Stable version recorded here. Refresh this checked-in baseline before every release.
